title: Learning to Price and Stock Under Contextual and Censored Demand
abstract: arXiv:2609.06083v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: To make optimal joint pricing and inventory control decisions is a critical challenge for modern retailers. In practice, retailers face changing market conditions where demands are influenced by various contextual factors, while simultaneously dealing with the difficulty of lost sales that obscure true demand information. However, existing approaches often fail to account for both contextual information and censored demand observations. We address this gap by presenting a framework where we model demand as a linear combination of basis functions with unknown coefficients, allowing for adaptive pricing and inventory decisions that respond to changing contexts. We propose an efficient algorithm to achieve regret bound $\mathcal{O}(K\sqrt{T}\log T)$ under concave revenue conditions and $\mathcal{O}(K^{2/3}T^{2/3}(\log T)^{1/2})$ for the general case, with matching lower bounds confirming optimality. translated_title: 情境化与删失需求下的定价与库存联合学习
translated_abstract: 对于现代零售商而言，做出最优的联合定价与库存控制决策是一项关键挑战。在实践中，零售商面临不断变化的市场环境，需求受到各种情境因素的影响，同时还要应对销售损失（lost sales）掩盖真实需求信息的困难。然而，现有方法往往无法同时考虑情境信息和删失需求观测。我们通过提出一个框架来弥补这一空白：在该框架中，我们将需求建模为具有未知系数的基函数的线性组合，从而实现能够响应环境变化的自适应定价与库存决策。我们提出了一种高效算法，在凹收益条件下实现了 O(K√T log T) 的遗憾界，在一般情形下实现了 O(K^(2/3)T^(2/3)(log T)^(1/2)) 的遗憾界，并且匹配的下界证实了算法的最优性。跨多个场景的大量数值实验验证了方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一个同时应对情境化需求与删失需求观测的联合定价与库存控制学习框架，通过将需求建模为基函数的线性组合并设计高效算法，实现了与理论下界匹配的最优遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a learning framework for joint pricing and inventory control under both contextual and censored demand observations, modeling demand as a linear combination of basis functions and designing efficient algorithms that achieve regret bounds matching the theoretical lower bounds.
